comment: Resident tax standard parameters. Sources: 地方税法 standard rates; prelaunch §1.8; gaps §4 framework. Municipality overrides live in resident-deviations.generated.json.

instalments.comment: 特別徴収: 12 instalments Jun-May; each month truncated to ¥100, remainder lands in June. Validated by B10.

nonTaxableThresholds.comment: 均等割 threshold: total income <= 350,000 x (1 + family) + 420,000 -> no flat levy. 所得割 threshold uses +320,000. Standard published formulas (級地 adjustments not modelled; disclosed on page).
